activity_summary: Heminges said you are not in the Shrew at two. You are in it Wednesday, in the comedy Thursday, and in the Shrew again Saturday. Garnish will keep the licensed book through Thursday and loose it on Saturday, after you are done. You did not ask for a new tally of Kemp's lines. You went home to the king.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named the days you are in, kept the book off the losses, and sent you home.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Held the book through Thursday, and refused a new tally.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked for Sunday's reading and agreed to wait until Saturday.

facets.activity: Went home and left the licensed book with Garnish

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: The Shrew at two. You are not in it, Will.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The book stays in my hand through Thursday.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Under my cloak on Sunday. No foul papers.
